{{Top|leg}}
'''Sith Runes''' was a form of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] that had various effects. Sith Runes usually had some form of protection as seen in the [[Valley of Golg]]. Sith Runes were used in ancient times to produce effects of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], which sometimes were included in rituals.<ref name="Wizard">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031030korriban5|series=Korriban: Planet of Lost Souls|text=Part 5: Sole Survivor}}</ref>
